title: Charge all calls while letting operational risk weight rare leakage
statement: The actual fixed-N observation F=9 f s b e_a e_j^T has mean pR and variance <=81p. Proper fitting and leakage-weighted Bell loss yield E ell<=min(p,41/N), including p=0 without division. A no-leakage history is common under W=I,X, giving lower regret (p/2)(1-p)^N and worst-p order 1/N even with stronger calibration.

requires: Known flag qubit and logical-size register with the exact stationary/reset two-branch channel family
Unknown fixed unitary W, labelled ordinary Pauli inputs, flag detection and local Pauli readout
Exactly N>=1 counted calibration calls followed by one fresh independent payload/reference and finite known-control implementation allowance
provides: A finite ordinary acquisition upper and calibration-then-one-use necessity at absolute risk
assumptions: No postselected leakage-branch guarantee or inverse-success stopping
Payload-dependent cross-use encoding or extra payload calls are excluded
Whole-experiment implementation discrepancy and all randomness are paid
costs: Every N input, flag and Pauli readout; rational 4x4 proper fitting, bounded axis sampler, controlled inverse and one payload
No inverse-p factor in absolute total Bell risk; estimating the leakage-conditional rotation still has rare-event cost
contract.units: Bell loss/global Bell-test failure and averaged half-diamond or permitted strategy distance only where the source supplies that conversion. Block calls, total qubit traffic, bits, controls, routing and memory are separate.
contract.obstruction: Conditional parameter accuracy and unconditional operational loss can have different rare-event costs.

evidence.quote: ## Ordinary qubit acquisition without a rare-success oracle
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Known flag/register factorization, stationary independent noise, ordinary preparations/readout and one fresh payload source call are substantial inputs. There is no free rare-success oracle, cheap relative orientation estimation, record-wise confidence, generic unflagged theorem or retained-memory import. The known-generator primary result is credited, not contradicted. A separate 768-run/688128-call floating SVD simulation is not this mathematical review, a rational-Jacobi production run or hardware. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed independent main/statistics review at the exact source version pinned in its receipt. Pending source headers are historical; actual conditional internal acceptance is sufficient. This insertion performs source correspondence and retrieval checks only.
